entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi... I hope you can help. I bought a pair of cycling shoes a while back, and they're just not working out for me. I'd like to return them.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Carbon cycling shoes, delivered on December 1st. To process this correctly, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it's just... they're so uncomfortable. I've tried everything, adjusted the cleats a dozen times, but I keep getting terrible blisters on every ride. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I'm just so disappointed. I saved up for these and I really needed the money back if they didn't work.

I'm very sorry to hear the shoes are causing blisters and not meeting your expectations. I can see you're a long-time customer, and we definitely want you to be happy with your gear. Let me check the return eligibility for you.
I really hope you can do something. I just want a refund so I can find something that works.
Of course. Let's see... Okay, good news. Your purchase falls within our 90-day return policy for standard items. I can go ahead and approve that return for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's... that's wonderful! Thank you so much. I was so worried.

You're very welcome. I'm happy we could resolve this for you. I've just emailed you a prepaid return shipping label. Just box up the shoes and drop them off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives them, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help, Sarah. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
